purpose: Normative rules for how plugin Python scripts return exit codes and error output, targeting machine-readable output that AI reads and branches on.
summary: Exit codes: 0 completed, 1 undifferentiated failure, 2 argument rejected by argparse, 3 or more script-specific
Completion judgment excludes result content; zero findings still exit 0
Meaning of codes 3 and above belongs only to the script returning them
Scripts returning 3 or more must declare a full exit code table in the module docstring, including 0
Wrappers passing through exit codes must declare the range or collapse to 0, 1, 2
Callers branch only on declared values; undeclared or 1 treated as undifferentiated error
Standard output: result JSON on 0, error JSON on non-zero, except 2 where argparse writes usage to stderr
Error JSON has an errors array of natural-language sentences
Diagnostics may go to stderr but error content must be in stdout JSON
Exception for harness-defined contracts such as hooks; applicability note for existing scripts
tasks: Writing a new plugin Python script
Writing a module docstring exit code table
Writing SKILL.md that handles script results
Writing wrapper scripts that pass through exit codes
